conversation.message: Collaborative filtering makes recommendations based on the preferences of similar users. It identifies patterns in user behavior to suggest items liked by others with comparable tastes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: One drawback is the "cold start" problem for new users or items without much data. Another is that it can sometimes reinforce existing popular items, limiting discovery of niche content.
